name: Robinhood
notes: Tracks net cash flowing in/out of the account. Skips Buy and Sell (share trades stay within Robinhood and are not cash events relative to your bank) and zero-amount share events. To match Robinhood's displayed portfolio value, set the account opening balance to: (Robinhood balance) minus (sum of imported transactions). Imported types: ACH deposits, CDIV dividends, SLIP stock-lending, ITRF transfers, DTAX/DFEE/AFEE fees, MRGC/LIQ/ROC/MISC/CIL cash.
